d919ed949e70f237.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كوربت عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تعزيز الحضور الرقمي للشركة وتنمية أعمالها في سوق الحلول التقنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التسويق الرقمي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنفيذ الاستراتيجية الرقمية بما يتوافق مع أهداف الشركة. إدارة الحملات الإعلانية وتحسين الأداء لتحقيق أفضل النتائج. متابعة وتحليل مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية وتقديم تقارير دورية. إدارة المحتوى الرقمي وحسابات التواصل الاجتماعي. التنسيق مع فرق التصميم والمبيعات لتطوير الحملات التسويقية. المساهمة في زيادة الوعي بالعلامة التجارية وتوليد العملاء المحتملين. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في التسويق الرقمي. خبرة في إدارة الحملات الإعلانية عبر منصات Meta و Google و TikTok. معرفة جيدة بتحسين محركات البحث (SEO) والتسويق بالمحتوى. القدرة على تحليل الأداء وقراءة التقارير والمؤشرات الرقمية. خبرة في إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي وصناعة المحتوى التسويقي. مهارة في إعداد الملفات والصفحات باستخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي. المهارات الشخصية مهارات تواصل ممتازة. القدرة على إدارة الوقت بفعالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. موقع العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

d9f3a756f26c0cd0.description: About KBR and the Role KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle, encompassing licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, and advanced design capabilities. KBR is seeking a Scheduler to join their team in Makkah or Rabigh. This full-time role involves developing and managing maintenance plans for various activities. Role Overview The Scheduler will be responsible for preparing and developing preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance plans on a weekly and monthly basis. These plans will cover mechanical, electrical, instrument, and general services maintenance activities, ensuring operational efficiency and asset availability. Key Responsibilities Prepare weekly and monthly routine and preventive maintenance plans, including all related activities. Ensure adequate resource planning and sourcing for the timely implementation and completion of planned maintenance activities. Analyze and document critical operational and maintenance issues affecting SATORP’s equipment, plants, and utilities availability. Liaise and participate in meetings with other Divisions to develop maintenance plans and schedules, providing technical input and recommendations as needed. Coordinate with the CET Division to evaluate progress against plans and conduct technical studies to recommend new practices for planning and implementation. Collaborate with all relevant stakeholders to ensure maintenance personnel, materials, spare parts, tools, and equipment are available for job execution. Prepare and maintain statistical maintenance and technical reports for routine and preventive maintenance activities at SATORP. Utilize SAP system, computer programs, and software for effective implementation of maintenance plans. Assist in preparing, developing, and measuring Contractor’s Key Performance Indicators. Maintain all historical records and databases of routine and preventive maintenance plans. Safety and Compliance Ensure compliance with all Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) rules. Encourage the reporting of unsafe acts and conditions. Comply with all SHE procedures prior to and during work activities. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in scheduling and maintenance planning. The role requires strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with multiple divisions and stakeholders. Application Process If you meet the qualifications and are interested in this full-time Scheduler position with KBR, please submit your application. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d9b2fa921932edbb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية عن محاضر للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة حفر الباطن. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الأكاديمي للطلبة من خلال التدريس والتقييم، والمساهمة في الأنشطة البحثية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدريس المسارات التخصصية لطلبة التعليم العالي. تقييم أداء الطلبة بشكل دوري وموضوعي. إجراء البحوث والدراسات المتخصصة في مجال الاختصاص. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بأداء الطلبة وتحصيلهم وتقدمهم الأكاديمي. إعداد خطط الدروس النظرية بما يتوافق مع المناهج المعتمدة. تصميم واختيار واستخدام التقنيات التعليمية الفاعلة لدعم العملية التعليمية. اختيار أساليب وطرق تدريس المادة النظرية للمسار الدراسي. تقديم المحاضرات في مجال التخصص بوضوح وفعالية. المشاركة في تنفيذ خطة الدراسات والأبحاث المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التدريس الأكاديمي أو البحث العلمي. القدرة على تدريس مسارات تخصصية لطلبة التعليم العالي. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاضر ضمن بيئة أكاديمية داعمة في أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية، في مدينة حفر الباطن بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، مما يتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام الأكاديمية والبحثية. عن أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية هي مؤسسة تعليمية ملتزمة بتقديم تعليم عالي الجودة والمساهمة في البحث العلمي. تسعى الأكاديمية إلى تطوير كوادر أكاديمية وبحثية متميزة لدعم رسالتها التعليمية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية.

d9b57ab54883f94b.description: About the Role flyadeal is seeking a Manager Service Excellence & Training to lead the development and delivery of service training programs for cabin crew. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on shaping customer service, handling service concerns, and enhancing onboard sales capabilities. Role Purpose The Manager Service Excellence & Training will establish onboard service standards and translate them into practical training modules for cabin crew at all career stages. The role also involves developing cabin leaders who can effectively coach their teams to deliver a consistent customer experience across the network. Key Responsibilities Develop onboard service standards and practical guides for cabin crew application on flights. Lead the design and delivery of initial, recurrent, upgrade, and refresher service training, including coordination for wet-lease and third-party crew. Identify training needs using customer feedback, Net Promoter Score (NPS) results, service audits, and flight reports. Implement blended learning approaches (instructor-led and digital) to improve customer engagement, emotional intelligence, and service recovery. Collaborate with Commercial and Inflight Services to develop onboard sales training that builds product knowledge, supports product recommendations, and ensures confident use of point-of-sale systems. Develop leadership training for Senior Cabin Crew, Cabin Managers, and service trainers, involving high-performing crew members in peer coaching. Maintain up-to-date training materials and audit-ready records in compliance with General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) requirements and company manuals. Coordinate with Safety and Emergency Procedures, Crew Resource Management, and Human Factors training teams for consistent guidance. Measure the impact of training on service quality and onboard sales, using findings to refine programs. Qualifications and Experience At least 8 years of aviation experience, with a minimum of 3 years leading cabin crew service training programs. Experience in onboard sales or retail training. Strong understanding of cabin crew operations, onboard service standards, and service recovery processes. Required Skills Ability to assess training needs, design and deliver learning programs, and evaluate their impact on performance. Strong communication, coaching, and project management skills. Demonstrated ability to develop cabin leaders and collaborate effectively across operational and commercial teams. Application Process Candidates with 5-10 years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

d9ef25f087bffb42.description: About the Role AbbVie is seeking a Brand Manager for Immunology to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on leading the understanding of patient experience insights within the Saudi market, developing a Saudi-specific Patient Journey, and ensuring patient-centric strategies for the Brand Team. The position requires 0-1 years of experience and operates within AbbVie's Code of Business Conduct, policies, and SFDA regulations. Key Responsibilities Lead the comprehension of patient experience insights for Brand and In-Field Teams in Saudi Arabia. Develop a Saudi-specific Patient Journey from symptom onset to long-term outcomes, focusing on patient-centric strategies. Collaborate with Brand and In-Field Team members to facilitate cross-stakeholder discussions with HCP and non-HCP stakeholders. Synthesize insights to identify target segments, determine brand positioning, and drive Closed Loop Marketing (CLM) engagement. Secure input for a robust Saudi Patient Journey that reflects local realities, such as referral pathways and diagnostic delays. Propose strategic objectives aligned with Vision 2030 Health Sector Transformation priorities and ensure patient-centricity in Brand Team strategies. Ensure all functional deliverables are consistent with global branding and localized for the Saudi market in Arabic and English. Guide the design and implementation of marketing activities, including omnichannel tactics, scientific platforms, and multi-stakeholder initiatives. Lead the development of marketing inputs for the Strategic Brand Plan and consolidate the 1-year Tactical Brand Plan. Forecast and monitor brand KPIs, manage the budget, and track ROI for marketing activities. Develop, lead, and coach direct reports (if applicable) and build marketing capability within the Business Unit. Lead the cross-functional Brand Team (if applicable) around a shared brand vision and objectives, ensuring collaboration and accountability. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Ability to lead comprehension of patient experience insights. Experience in developing patient journeys and patient-centric strategies. Capability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders, including HCP and non-HCP groups. Proficiency in synthesizing insights for market segmentation and brand positioning. Understanding of local market realities, including referral pathways and formulary cycles. Experience in marketing execution, including omnichannel tactics and partnerships. Skills in brand planning, forecasting, and budget management. Compliance and Standards The role requires adherence to the AbbVie Code of Business Conduct, AbbVie policies, SFDA regulations, and Saudi pharmaceutical promotion codes. All promotional materials must pass AbbVie's internal review and approval process and comply with SFDA requirements before use. d96da64b4ce9278b.description: About the Collections Specialist Role Gulf Bio Analytical Group is seeking a Collections Specialist to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position designed for individuals with 0-1 year of experience, focusing on maintaining accurate financial flows and ensuring timely collection processes. The role is integral to supporting the treasury and credit & collection functions within the company. Key Responsibilities Ensure the accuracy of cash flow projections for assigned regions or territories. Manage cash in-flow forecasts on a rolling quarterly basis. Oversee timely invoice submission for the designated territory, adhering to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Verify that cash application of receipts is accurate and complete within the ERP and CRM systems. Prepare reports for weekly reviews, providing status updates to the treasury and credit & collection team lead. Identify and address issues or delays in customer collections, implementing necessary corrective actions. Assist the Credit & Collection Team Lead with the preparation of Management Information System (MIS) reports. Required Experience and Skills Candidates for this role should possess 0-1 year of relevant experience. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial data accurately. Proficiency in using ERP and CRM systems for financial transactions and reporting is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Collections Specialist will work collaboratively within the credit and collections team, reporting to the Credit & Collection Team Lead and interacting with the treasury department. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this role. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

d90e1299240bb646.description: About the Role Primark is seeking a Visual Merchandising Manager to deliver and maintain exemplary standards of visual merchandising. This full-time role involves designing promotional campaigns, providing recommendations, and implementing action plans to enhance the brand's visual presence. Key Responsibilities Design and implement promotional campaigns to support visual merchandising objectives. Provide recommendations and implement action plans to achieve high visual standards. Train store staff on brand visual merchandising standards and provide ongoing coaching. Collaborate with the brand team on plans for new store openings and market entry strategies. PSA BDP serves more than 5,000 customers, including multinational companies in the chemical, retail & consumer, life sciences & pharmaceuticals, and electric vehicle & industrial sectors. The Logistics Service Coordinator Role PSA BDP is seeking a Logistics Service Coordinator to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves managing various aspects of logistics operations to ensure efficient and timely service delivery. The coordinator will be responsible for end-to-end processing of orders and shipments. Key Responsibilities Manage order processing, including plausibility analysis of customer orders. Plan, book, and execute transportation orders. Coordinate and follow up on shipments. Handle customs processing for both export and import activities. Provide feedback to customers through various channels such as mail, phone, and EDI, including internal and external reporting of shipments. Address operational troubleshooting issues. The company emphasizes core values that extend across its global operations, offering opportunities for professional growth within the organization.

d9656f773c807d87.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to contribute to a significant mega-development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the delivery of a landmark program that includes extensive utility networks, substations, smart infrastructure, and various associated electrical assets, contributing to urban transformation initiatives within the Kingdom. The Electrical Engineer will provide technical expertise across the design review, construction supervision, testing, commissioning, and handover phases of the project. Role Context and Objectives Working within the PMCM team, the Electrical Engineer will ensure that all electrical systems are designed, installed, tested, and operated in accordance with project requirements, international standards, regulatory guidelines, and client expectations. The role requires close collaboration with multidisciplinary project teams to deliver safe, reliable, sustainable, and efficient electrical infrastructure. The project encompasses large-scale utility networks, street lighting systems, landscape electrical systems, transportation infrastructure, pumping stations, and public realm developments. Key Responsibilities Review and assess electrical designs, calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical submissions for infrastructure and landscape-related projects. Provide technical oversight of electrical works during construction to ensure compliance with approved designs, standards, and project requirements. Support the coordination and integration of electrical systems across various infrastructure components, including utility networks, substations, and lighting systems. Review contractor shop drawings, material submissions, method statements, and testing procedures. Conduct site inspections and monitor electrical installation works to verify quality, safety, and compliance. Support the implementation and verification of power distribution networks, MV/LV systems, control systems, and backup power systems. Coordinate with civil, mechanical, ICT, smart city, utilities, and landscape teams to resolve design and construction interface issues. Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, technical workshops, and value engineering exercises. Monitor project progress and provide technical input on schedule, quality, risk management, and project performance. Review testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and handover documentation for electrical systems and assets. Ensure compliance with local authority requirements, international electrical standards, and project governance procedures. Identify technical risks, construction challenges, and design discrepancies, recommending practical engineering solutions. Prepare technical reports, review comments, inspection records, and engineering recommendations. Support successful project delivery through proactive stakeholder engagement and effective technical leadership. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum of 10-15 years of experience in electrical engineering for major infrastructure, utilities, transportation, public realm, or landscape development projects. Proven experience working on large-scale infrastructure projects involving substations, power distribution networks, street lighting, utility systems, and associated electrical assets. Strong knowledge of MV/LV systems, electrical power distribution, lighting systems, grounding systems, protection systems, and electrical safety requirements. Experience reviewing electrical calculations, design packages, engineering drawings, technical specifications, and contractor submissions. Familiarity with international codes and standards including IEC, IEEE, NFPA, BS, and relevant local authority requirements. Experience supporting testing, commissioning, energization, and handover activities for infrastructure electrical systems. Proficiency in electrical engineering software and analytical tools such as ETAP, SKM Power Tools, DIALux, AutoCAD, Revit, or equivalent platforms. Strong understanding of construction supervision, quality assurance, health and safety requirements, and risk management practices. Excellent technical, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within PMCM, engineering consultancy, owner representative, or client-side organizations is desirable. Previous experience on GCC infrastructure projects, particularly in Saudi Arabia, is advantageous. Professional registration or membership with recognized engineering institutions is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, supporting a large-scale urban transformation initiative. The role involves working within a multidisciplinary project team, collaborating with various stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

d9809009123c5b62.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عابد علي الحبشي للمقاولات عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية من خلال تحديد المخاطر المهنية وتطوير الإجراءات الوقائية ومراقبة تطبيقها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية في مواقع العمل. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات فعالة لتفادي تأثيرات هذه المخاطر على العاملين. تنسيق تحويل العاملين للفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمعايير المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين ظروف العمل. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال تنفيذ جميع أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بالمخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية في بيئة العمل. القدرة على قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج. فهم جيد لإجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المخاطر وتقييمها. القدرة على تصميم وتطوير برامج لمنع الأمراض المهنية. مهارات إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية بدقة. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة العامة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمساهمة في بيئة عمل آمنة ومستدامة ضمن شركة عابد علي الحبشي للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

d98d3118ea18d84a.description: About the Role Foodics, a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider, is seeking an AI Engineer to join its engineering team. This full-time position involves constructing agentic AI architecture and leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. The role focuses on hands-on backend software engineering, including coding, testing, and system diagnostics, within a compact team environment. Key Responsibilities Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces. Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers with precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers. Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions, adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards. Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and capture production edge cases. Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency. Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers. Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization. Qualifications and Requirements Deep software engineering expertise in a modern programming language, with an emphasis on algorithmic depth. Strong computer science foundations in data structures, algorithms, memory allocation, and concurrent execution patterns. Practical experience with backend infrastructure: REST/gRPC APIs, relational/non-relational databases, caching tiers, message queues, and distributed systems resilience. Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing clean, maintainable software. Comprehensive understanding of LLM mechanics: context window constraints, tokenization, function calling protocols, non-deterministic behaviors, and hallucination management. Demonstrated history of delivering full-lifecycle technical projects across production environments, academic work, open source, or side initiatives. Methodical debugging skills with the ability to articulate systematic troubleshooting methodologies. Strong technical documentation and written communication skills to articulate complex distributed system behaviors. Seniority Level Expectations Early Career: Focuses on technical foundations, algorithmic problem-solving, and curiosity. Mentorship is provided for scope expansion over well-defined modules. Mid-Level: Owns sub-systems end-to-end, translates ambiguous requirements into robust architecture, and demonstrates a track record of shipping and maintaining production services. Senior Level: Drives strategic architectural direction, possesses hands-on experience scaling non-deterministic systems, elevates team-wide engineering practices, and actively challenges technical assumptions. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience developing application prototypes integrated with LLM APIs. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or custom tool integrations. Understanding of vector database indexing, embedding generation, and retrieval pipelines (RAG). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), telemetry, or IaC tooling. Knowledge of GenAI security paradigms, prompt injection mitigation, and threat modeling. Active open-source contributions or community engagement. Engineering Standards The engineering environment adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning integrated into the onboarding process. Key standards include: Model Context Protocol (MCP): An open standard for integrating models with tool services and data stores. OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions: Standardized instrumentation schemas for tracking model execution traces, step transitions, and tool invocations. OWASP GenAI & Agentic Security Guidelines: Threat modeling standards emphasizing containment strategies, least-privilege tooling, strict input sanitization, and authorization gates. Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses.

d991e266b664e485.description: About the Role SSC is seeking a Senior Marketing Executive - F&B/QSR to manage marketing activities for multiple restaurant brands, including Thai cuisine and quick-service restaurants (QSR). This is a full-time position that requires a hands-on and organized approach to marketing. Role Overview The Senior Marketing Executive will be responsible for developing comprehensive marketing plans, executing campaigns, and managing product launches across various F&B brands. The role involves close coordination with external agencies and a focus on monitoring performance through key performance indicators (KPIs) and sales reports. The ideal candidate will possess strong F&B marketing experience and excellent coordination skills to translate marketing strategies into measurable business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Develop annual and quarterly marketing plans, encompassing campaigns, communication strategies, marketing calendars, and KPIs. Maintain an updated marketing calendar that covers all assigned brands. Ensure consistent brand identity while preserving the unique positioning of each individual brand. Manage marketing campaigns and product launches from conception to execution. Coordinate effectively with external agencies to ensure timely and successful project delivery. Monitor marketing performance using established KPIs and analyze sales reports to assess effectiveness. d99283bedb7d91e3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من تقييم الحالة الصحية وحتى توثيق الإجراءات الطبية، مع ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض، وجمع البيانات من المريض وذويه، وتوثيقها وتحليلها لتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. إعداد خطة الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها بشكل دوري. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقًا لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية بحسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج، والمشاركة في عملية الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. توثيق جميع الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي بدقة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمريض. القدرة على إعداد خطط الرعاية التمريضية ومتابعة تنفيذها. معرفة بإجراءات أخذ العينات الحيوية والمخبرية. القدرة على إعطاء الأدوية والمحاليل الوريدية بدقة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في تقييم الحالات الصحية وجمع البيانات. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العامة في بيئة العمل. القدرة على توثيق الإجراءات الطبية بدقة واحترافية. القدرة على تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات في أبها، عسير. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع المرضى والعمل ضمن فريق طبي متكامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

d9b1d57924519460.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Plant Propagator to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for the propagation, establishment, and management of plant material essential for supporting Botanic Gardens' living collections, displays, conservation programs, and horticulture operations. The Plant Propagator will apply a variety of propagation methods to produce healthy and genetically appropriate plant stock. Key Responsibilities Propagate plants using diverse techniques, including seeds, cuttings, grafting, budding, layering, and division. Select appropriate propagation methods based on species characteristics, seasonal needs, plant condition, and collection objectives. Collect, prepare, process, and store seeds and vegetative propagation material. Prepare suitable propagation media and containers according to species-specific requirements. Apply necessary seed treatments such as scarification, stratification, or soaking. Monitor germination, rooting, establishment, growth, and overall plant health throughout the propagation process. Identify and address propagation challenges, including poor germination, rooting failure, disease, pests, and nutrient deficiencies. Manage and maintain nursery and propagation areas, ensuring optimal growing conditions, hygiene, and plant-care standards. Coordinate the movement of successfully propagated plants to nursery, greenhouse, indoor, or outdoor garden environments. Develop, test, document, and refine species-specific propagation protocols, especially for rare, endangered, or difficult-to-propagate species. Conduct propagation trials to enhance germination, rooting, survival, and establishment rates. Collaborate with curators, botanists, horticulturists, and conservation specialists to define propagation priorities. Maintain detailed records of propagation activities, methods, source material, dates, treatments, and success rates. Implement appropriate nursery hygiene, sanitation, plant-health, and biosecurity procedures. Support Integrated Pest Management (IPM) within nursery and propagation areas. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, Plant Biology, or a related discipline. Specialist training or certification in plant propagation, nursery management, or seed technology is advantageous. Experience: Minimum of 5-10 years of relevant professional experience in plant propagation and nursery horticulture. Demonstrated experience propagating plants using multiple methods, including seeds and cuttings. Practical experience with grafting, budding, layering, division, and other vegetative propagation techniques. Experience selecting, collecting, preparing, and handling seed and vegetative propagation material. Demonstrated experience with seed germination, dormancy-breaking treatments, and seedling establishment. Experience managing nursery areas and plant stock for botanic, horticulture, landscape, or comparable plant collections. Experience monitoring and managing irrigation, humidity, temperature, shade, growing media, and plant nutrition in nursery environments. Experience monitoring plant health and addressing pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and environmental stresses during propagation. Demonstrated experience developing, testing, or refining plant propagation protocols. Experience propagating rare, endangered, sensitive, or difficult-to-propagate species is preferred. Experience maintaining detailed propagation records and monitoring success rates. Experience implementing nursery hygiene, sanitation, biosecurity, and Integrated Pest Management practices. Previous experience within a botanic garden, nursery, arboretum, or conservation facility is preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

Collaborate with team members to develop resources for the foundation program, including revision materials, test question banks, and remedial resources. d901488b67174a0f.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an Assistant Manager - Training to join our team in Medina. This full-time role focuses on supporting the identification and addressing of employee and organizational development needs. The position is instrumental in ensuring effective training programs are in place to achieve desired business results, covering areas such as product knowledge, company philosophy, customer service, and leadership skills. Demonstrate leadership in guest hospitality and customer service, fostering a positive atmosphere for guest relations. Assist employees in identifying specific behaviors that contribute to service excellence. Ensure employees receive ongoing training to understand and meet guest expectations. Utilize effective training methods to ensure employees comprehend and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills. Meet regularly with the training cadre to support ongoing training efforts. Observe employee service behaviors and provide constructive feedback to individuals and/or managers. Training Program Development and Evaluation Assist in conducting needs assessments, designing, and developing training programs. Meet regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns. d913825ab09132d5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بيت التكييف للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية، وإعداد قوائم المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة، بالإضافة إلى قياس الأعمال المنجزة وتدقيقها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد والأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية عن الأعمال المنجزة. قياس الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير وقوائم المواد. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة المباني ضمن فريق متخصص في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب المتابعة الميدانية والتنسيق المستمر لضمان جودة أعمال الصيانة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة بيت التكييف للمقاولات، يرجى التقديم على هذا الدور في الدمام.

d9640eaa10a9b058.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة انفال الإدارية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال المبيعات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق، وتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع، ومتابعة تنفيذ السياسات والطرق البيعية المعتمدة. وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية لتعزيز المبيعات. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم وتقديم الحلول المناسبة. متابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية المحتملة. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية المحددة. اقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية لتحسين الأداء البيعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول الملائمة. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ التقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو دور مماثل. فهم عميق لسياسات البيع وأساليب التسويق. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الأهداف البيعية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم الأداء البيعي وتحديد مجالات التحسين. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الاستراتيجية. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت لضمان إنجاز المهام بفعالية. إتقان إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة انفال الإدارية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تحقيق الأهداف المهنية والشخصية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

d972ba9203d9e746.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي شبكات توزيع أرضية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتنفيذ وصيانة شبكات التوزيع الأرضية، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة شبكات التوزيع الأرضية، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: دراسة المخططات التنفيذية الخاصة بتمديد وتوصيل شبكات التوزيع الأرضية والكابلات. تقدير الكميات اللازمة من المواد والأجهزة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها، ومتابعة تأمينها لتنفيذ الأعمال. متابعة تنفيذ برامج أعمال تمديد وتوصيل الكابلات، وتوزيع المهام على فرق العمل، والتنسيق مع الجهات الهندسية الأخرى. الكشف على مسار الكابلات، ومتابعة أعمال الحفر والتمديد والطمر، بالإضافة إلى متابعة إجراء وصلات الكابلات وتوصيل نهاياتها بعناصر منظومة التوزيع. متابعة تحديد مواقع الأعطال والوصلات، وتأريض واستعزال الكابلات، وتشخيص أعطالها، ومتابعة إجراءات إصلاحها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات التنفيذية لشبكات التوزيع الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأجهزة شبكات التوزيع الأرضية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. التقديم لمزيد من المعلومات حول هذا الدور أو للتقديم، يرجى التواصل مع شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات.

d969870b9ed37b08.description: About the Role Lifera is seeking a Portfolio Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position responsible for coordinating delivery oversight and portfolio performance across assigned portfolios, programs, subsidiaries, and functions. The role involves consolidating project and program information, challenging delivery statuses, managing cross-project dependencies, and preparing inputs for governance, escalation, and decision-making processes. While this role provides critical oversight and coordination, Project Sponsors, Program Leads, Project Managers, and Business Owners retain their defined accountabilities for delivery and outcomes. Key Responsibilities Coordinate delivery oversight across assigned portfolios, programs, subsidiaries, functions, and Group projects. Maintain a consolidated view of projects, programs, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and benefits. Validate and challenge project and program RAG status, forecasts, recovery actions, and reporting quality. Consolidate project updates into comprehensive program and portfolio performance views. Maintain integrated program roadmaps and monitor cross-project dependencies and decision requirements. Lead weekly Project Delivery Reviews for assigned areas and support the Portfolio & Program Review. Prepare governance packs, escalation inputs, decision requirements, and recommended actions. Coordinate with Project Sponsors, Program Sponsors, Program Leads, Project Managers, and Business Owners to resolve information gaps and progress actions. Demonstrated ability to coordinate delivery oversight and manage portfolio performance. Experience in consolidating project and program information and challenging delivery statuses. Proficiency in managing cross-project dependencies and preparing governance inputs. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on coordinating and optimizing portfolio and program delivery. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this Portfolio Manager position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d9c311366434e107.description: About the Role Ninja is seeking a Ground Operation Officer to support daily last-mile delivery operations. d9c8c68fc82b6e18.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة روابي القابضة عن مشرف مسكن للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق اللوائح المنظمة للسكن وتوفير بيئة آمنة ومريحة للمقيمين، مع التركيز على متابعة الخدمات الأساسية والنظافة العامة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق والالتزام باللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المنظمة لأعمال السكن بشكل دوري. إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة بالساكنين ومتابعة تحديثها وتطويرها باستمرار. متابعة توفير الخدمات العامة الأساسية مثل الماء والكهرباء والاتصالات لضمان استمراريتها. الإشراف على النظافة العامة والشروط الصحية والسلامة العامة والأمن في السكن. توفير الخدمات الطبية الطارئة عند الحاجة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة وتطبيق اللوائح والتعليمات بدقة. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لإدارة قواعد البيانات والتقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف المسكن بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة روابي القابضة في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، ويساهم في توفير بيئة معيشية منظمة وآمنة للمقيمين. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة روابي القابضة.

d9e8220b5e4b416f.description: About the Role Premium Food Company is seeking a Hospitality Manager to lead the assessment and improvement of hospitality performance across its restaurant portfolio. This full-time role is based in Makkah and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The Hospitality Manager will work directly with Customer Experience and Operations leadership to identify guest-experience gaps and ensure sustainable improvement in service delivery. Key Responsibilities Conduct planned and unannounced restaurant visits to evaluate the complete dine-in journey and document evidence-based findings across brands, branches, dayparts, and peak periods. Utilize audits, guest feedback, complaints, NPS, reviews, and mystery shopper results to identify root causes, prioritize risks, agree on owners and deadlines, and verify sustained closure of issues. Provide hands-on coaching and practical training for managers, supervisors, hosts, cashiers, waiters, captains, and other frontline employees, demonstrating behaviors and confirming competence on the live floor. Equip Area and Restaurant Managers to brief, observe, recognize, correct, and follow up on hospitality performance every shift, escalating repeated gaps and recommending appropriate interventions. Translate approved hospitality standards into natural, observable behaviors suited to each brand level, avoiding robotic or scripted interactions. Improve preference discovery, menu storytelling, personalized recommendations, hospitality-led suggestive selling, attentiveness, and memorable guest experiences. Coach teams to recognize dissatisfaction, listen, empathize, apologize, take ownership, act within approved authority, escalate correctly, follow up, and confirm satisfaction. Partner with CX, Operations, and Training leaders, maintain concise performance reporting, track corrective actions, highlight systemic risks and best practices, and recommend continuous improvements. Decision-Making Authority Conduct announced and unannounced assessments and coach employees and managers directly during visits. Require corrective-action plans, agree on deadlines with Operations, and request retraining or reassessment. Escalate critical or repeated failures and recommend recognition, development, reassignment, or performance intervention. Contribute to decisions on hospitality standards, training, assessment, certification, and leadership capability. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in hospitality management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to assess performance, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions. Experience in coaching and training frontline employees and management. Work Location This position is based in the Makkah region, with responsibilities covering locations in Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d98c1d4d4c5881ec.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Lead Ethics Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves leading the development and implementation of proactive measures to uphold ethical standards and prevent misconduct within the Bank Group. The specialist will contribute significantly to the organization's learning and its transformation into a knowledge-based entity. Key Responsibilities Monitor and report on planned prevention activities and programs to ensure compliance with the Bank Group Code of Ethics. Handle complex, sensitive, and confidential assignments independently. Deliver ethics products and services to IsDB Group staff and provide oversight on the interpretation of the Code of Ethics and related policies. Support the Director in developing and executing communications, training, and education programs to inform staff of ethical obligations. Lead complex training and communications projects, including writing articles, giving presentations, and developing communication materials. Oversee the preparation of annual reports and other written products for the Department Director. Assist in keeping IsDB Group Units informed on relevant ethics issues and oversee data analysis to identify trends and major issues. Recommend and implement policies, procedures, and targeted programs for strategic use. Supervise consultants and oversee contracts as requested by the Director. Support activities related to allegations of staff misconduct and play a key role in reviewing and developing internal procedures and manuals. Mainstream ethics into Bank Group policy documents and engage departments on lessons learned. Organize and oversee training, capacity building, awareness-raising, and sensitization activities to enhance ethical conduct. Develop presentations and materials for the prevention of staff misconduct. Lead the launch and implementation of the Financial Disclosure and Conflict of Interests Program. Undertake staff misconduct investigations and prepare corresponding reports. Spearhead the identification and organization of collaborative partnerships with regional and international trainers for staff training programs. Knowledge Management Contributions Lead the organization and implementation of meetings, workshops, and video conferences to promote dialogue on integrity and ethics. Provide administrative and technical support on ethics issues during major events. Lead the preparation of a periodic newsletter on Ethics Prevention and Outreach Products. Prepare annual integrity and ethics reports and ensure their publication. Lead special initiatives/projects and undertake ad hoc assignments as required. Capacity Building and Advisory Functions Lead, organize, and oversee the implementation of training and awareness activities for staff misconduct prevention. Lead in designing and developing innovative training tools and modules based on data analysis to enhance staff expertise. Lead the implementation of a Training and Awareness Plan for staff capacity building and sensitization. Advise IsDB Group Staff on the provisions of the IsDB Group Code of Ethics. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, within the Islamic Development Bank Group.

d9d462712c0b32e0.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Laundry Attendant to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves operating and monitoring laundry machinery to ensure the cleanliness and proper handling of all laundered items. The role is based in Makkah, with operations also extending to Jeddah. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor washing, dry cleaning, and drying machinery, including adding necessary chemicals and cleaning lint traps. Identify stained or damaged items and determine appropriate action for repair, spot treatment, rewash, or discard. Inspect the cleanliness of articles removed from machines and place them into clean linen carts. Set dryers to designated times and temperatures based on fabric types. Remove lint and debris from dryer screens, dry cleaning filters, and drain traps after each load. Fold cleaned articles to designated sizes, either by hand or using a folding machine. Maintain accurate records of all laundered items. Adhere to all company safety and security policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions to management. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support team goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards, and identify opportunities for efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, or cost-savings improvements. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Maneuver through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Navigate sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as stairs and service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Qualifications and Experience No high school diploma or *** equivalent is required. No prior related work experience is necessary for this role. No supervisory experience is required. No specific license or certification is needed. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the hospitality industry, based in Makkah. The role requires adherence to established company policies and procedures, including safety training and certifications. The successful candidate will work as part of a team, contributing to the overall efficiency and quality of laundry operations.

d9db9413362872e1.description: About the Role NHC is seeking a Network Infrastructure Senior Engineer to join their team in Makkah, with work locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves designing, developing, and overseeing the implementation of network infrastructure for large-scale residential community development projects. The successful candidate will ensure secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity in compliance with applicable standards and regulations. Key Responsibilities Design network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, wireless, fiber optic, and structured cabling systems. Coordinate network infrastructure designs with civil, electrical, and other engineering disciplines to ensure seamless integration across development projects. Develop network diagrams, topology layouts, and technical documentation. Coordinate with engineering teams, contractors, and vendors to ensure successful network infrastructure deployment. Oversee network installation, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Ensure compliance with telecommunications standards, cybersecurity requirements, and safety regulations. Prepare network infrastructure progress reports and provide technical support to project teams. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent field. A minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in network infrastructure or a related field. Demonstrated knowledge of LAN, WAN, wireless networks, fiber optics, and structured cables. Experience in network infrastructure design, installation, and troubleshooting. Familiarity with telecommunications standards and cybersecurity requirements. d9ea99f34cd25b18.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform designed for emerging markets, recognized as a Great Place to Work®. With over 25 years of conversational AI research and development, Unifonic serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA. The company is pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform, focusing on how it is perceived by buyers, analysts, media, and the broader market. The Sales Team at Unifonic The Sales team at Unifonic is responsible for driving revenue while serving as trusted consultants to customers. This team comprises experts in account management, business development, and customer service, collaborating with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs. The team seeks individuals with a track record of success in sales, an aptitude for relationship building, and a commitment to customer support. Role Overview: Key Account Manager As a Key Account Manager based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with strategic enterprise customers while driving business growth. This full-time role involves managing key accounts, understanding customer business objectives, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering value through Unifonic's solutions. The Key Account Manager will act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, develop strategic account plans, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success, retention, and revenue growth. This position requires 5-10 years of experience, exceptional relationship management skills, strategic thinking, and strong commercial acumen to achieve business objectives and maximize long-term customer value. Key Responsibilities Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise customers. Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders and executive sponsors. Create and execute strategic account plans. Identify opportunities for account expansion through additional products and services. Conduct regular business reviews and ensure customer satisfaction. Collaborate with Customer Success and other internal teams to maximize customer value. Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, and CRM records. Identify opportunities to expand business within existing accounts. Build relationships with prospective enterprise customers through networking, referrals, and industry engagement. Lead commercial discussions and solution presentations. Prepare proposals, negotiate contracts, and support the sales process through deal closure. Contribute to achieving the team’s revenue and growth objectives. Required Character Traits Analytical thinking and problem-solving: Ability to approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. Ownership and accountability: Takes responsibility and follows projects through to completion. Communication: Explains ideas clearly and listens to others across teams. Collaboration: Works effectively with others and supports team goals. Adaptability and learning: Adjusts to change and continuously acquires new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing: Supports the growth of others and shares expertise. Resilience: Maintains composure under pressure and handles setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail: Performs work carefully and strives for continuous improvement. Advocacy and innovation: Encourages best practices, efficiency, and new ideas.

d99067db7c579883.description: About the Role Kempinski Hotels is seeking a Sales Manager to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on achieving hotel revenue targets by optimizing sales from an assigned account base and prospecting new clients in designated markets. The primary measure of performance will be against established revenue goals. Key Responsibilities Manage key accounts within an assigned base or geographic area to maximize revenue, achieve personal targets, and increase market share against competitors. Prospect and acquire new accounts. Oversee all segments of assigned geographical markets, which may include European markets. Conduct site inspections for potential clients. Adhere to Corporate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Follow up on tentative bookings within assigned markets. Maintain detailed knowledge of the competitor set and all hotel services, facts, and figures. Ensure timely contracting with clients. Implement SMART contracting strategies for optimal yielding during annual rate negotiations. Attend trade shows, sales blitzes, and workshops in assigned markets. Assist the Director of Sales / Director of Sales & Marketing in defining and executing the annual sales action plan. Support the Director of Sales / Director of Sales & Marketing with annual budget preparation by providing account production statistics and forecasts. Execute sales actions within the allocated cost budget structure. Document all sales activities in SFA (S&C) and update the OPERA contact database regularly. Cross-sell other Kempinski Hotels. Understand and adhere to the Company Sales Vision. Participate in the Duty Manager rota. Strictly adhere to the Rules & Regulations in the Employees Handbook and the Hotel’s policy on Fire, Hygiene, Health & Safety. Report and rectify all potential and real hazards immediately. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in sales, preferably within the hospitality sector. Demonstrated ability to achieve revenue targets and manage client accounts effectively. Proficiency in sales documentation systems such as SFA (S&C) and OPERA. The role involves interaction with various departments and participation in a Duty Manager rota. d99516e5154f9ed8.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Social Services Social Worker to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves providing essential support to patients and their families, ensuring their needs are met during their visits or stay at Fakeeh Healthcare facilities. The position is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to establish direct and indirect contact with patients, ensuring that Fakeeh Healthcare facility services meet their expectations and that patient complaints are addressed. The Social Services Social Worker assists and supports patients and their families through stressful and difficult situations, helping them find appropriate solutions during their time at the facility. Key Responsibilities Provide non-medical and non-nursing patient care and support. Coordinate Care Management services related to patient care. Offer administrative support, including obtaining medical reports in Arabic from the Medical Records Department. Address the social concerns of patients and conduct psychosocial assessments and counseling. Perform daily rounds for new admissions in Pediatric and Adult Oncology, BHU, regular rounds for long-stay patients (>7 days), and monthly rounds in RDU if applicable. Document relevant care in the EMR using the non-MD template. Provide follow-up services to appropriate patients and families. Participate in preparing treatment plans, especially for patients with psychosocial issues or at the end of life, requiring specific resources like family support, transport, or financial assistance. Collaborate with internal multidisciplinary teams, providers, allied health staff, patients, caregivers, and visitors. Participate in preparing discharge plans to facilitate patients' return home with optimal functioning conditions, if applicable. Respond to referrals for inpatients, outpatients (RDU, special needs, kidney transplant patients), and ER cases as per Fakeeh Care policy, if applicable. Actively participate in the End-of-Life Care team, supporting families through loss and grief situations (*, Code Mercy and Code Blue). Provide support to families of DNR (Do Not Resuscitate) patients. Assist patients with financial needs by preparing case studies and referring them to charity channels. Help patients and families obtain financial estimates for service prices when needed. Manage the DAMA (Discharge Against Medical Advice) process, track cases, contact patients who refuse admission or continuation of care, and prepare DAMA KPI reports with corrective action plans for HEC quarterly, if applicable. Provide special care for patients with specific needs, including the terminally ill, handicapped, victims of abuse or domestic violence, and those with non-psychiatric social problems. Coordinate the reporting process for abuse and domestic violence cases to MOH and HRSD, and report cases to the Violence and Abuse Protection Committee. Issue "Priority to Them" Cards and parking eligibility stickers for special needs patients per Fakeeh Care policy. Assist in arranging for clergy and interpreters for patients when needed. Coordinate with the Finance department to define financial coverage and limits. Attend committees and meetings as recommended. Arrange and attend family/physician meetings. Screen and support patients and families in ICU, CCU, NICU, and PICU, if applicable. Maintain and update a list of interpreters, clergy, and sign language experts. Accumulate and maintain information on community resources and programs to meet patient needs. For kidney transplant cases, conduct psychosocial evaluations, present data, address identified problems to the transplant committee, and educate patients regarding post-transplant expectations, including medication and insurance coverage, if applicable. Perform other duties as assigned within the scope of the job. Experience and Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on direct patient interaction and coordination within a healthcare setting. Location The role is based in the Makkah region, with responsibilities covering facilities in Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

d984bf19af13cde5.description: About the Role Alpin is seeking an experienced Land Surveyor to support major infrastructure and urban development projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves planning, executing, and coordinating various surveying activities to ensure the accuracy and traceability of survey information for design and construction phases. Key Responsibilities Plan and conduct land, topographic, route, and construction surveys across project sites. Establish and maintain survey control points, benchmarks, and reference systems essential for project delivery. Perform setting-out, alignment, levelling, and as-built surveys, and verify the accuracy of completed works. Collect, process, and validate field survey data using appropriate equipment and digital workflows. Review survey information against drawings, models, and project requirements, identifying discrepancies and coordinating corrective actions. Review and validate survey data and deliverables prepared by third-party surveyors. Prepare and maintain survey records, field notes, drawings, reports, and as-built information in a controlled and auditable manner. Coordinate surveying activities and outputs with engineering, design, BIM/GIS, and construction teams, supporting the planning of additional site surveys and investigations as needed. Lead and coordinate survey teams, promoting safe working practices and consistent survey quality. Support specialist survey activities such as cadastral mapping, 3D scanning, or point-cloud data processing when required by the project. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of professional experience in land surveying, including major infrastructure and construction projects. Bachelor’s degree in Surveying, Geomatics Engineering, or a closely related discipline, OR a Master of Engineering (MEng) in Geomatics Engineering. Strong practical experience in setting-out, alignment, levelling, topographic surveys, and as-built verification. Demonstrated ability to coordinate survey teams and manage survey information across multidisciplinary projects. Relevant professional certification or membership is preferred. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on large-scale infrastructure and urban development projects. The role requires collaboration with various engineering and construction teams. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d94eb9b2d8123965.description: About the Role BIG Academy is seeking qualified and experienced Faculty members specializing in Business, Accounting, and Finance to join its academic team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on delivering engaging, practical, and industry-oriented teaching across various business disciplines. Role Overview The Faculty member will be responsible for delivering lectures and practical sessions, guiding students through assignments and projects, and conducting assessments. Additionally, this role involves contributing to curriculum development and maintaining academic quality standards within the institution. Key Responsibilities Deliver lectures, tutorials, and practical sessions in Business Management, Accounting, Finance, and related subjects. Prepare lesson plans, presentations, case studies, assignments, and other teaching materials aligned with the curriculum. Explain business, accounting, and financial concepts using practical examples, industry applications, and case-based learning. Guide students in academic assignments, projects, presentations, and research activities. Prepare and evaluate assessments, quizzes, examination papers, and assignments, providing timely and constructive feedback. Monitor student attendance, academic progress, and performance, offering support as needed. Maintain accurate academic records, grades, and attendance using institutional SIS and LMS platforms. Ensure compliance with academic regulations, assessment procedures, and institutional quality standards. Contribute to curriculum development, assessment moderation, faculty development, and academic improvement initiatives. Stay updated on industry trends, business practices, financial developments, and relevant professional standards. Participate in faculty meetings, workshops, orientations, seminars, and other institutional activities. Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of experience in a relevant academic or industry role. Strong subject knowledge in Business Management, Accounting, Finance, and related disciplines. Ability to deliver engaging, practical, and industry-oriented teaching. d9936c0b5194d1f6.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة يعلن مجمع دار الدخيل الطبي عن توفر وظيفة أخصائي تقنية إشعاعية بدوام كامل في مدينة تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تجهيز المرضى للتصوير، وإجراء الفحوصات الإشعاعية، وضمان جودة الصور، بالإضافة إلى حفظ وتوثيق التقارير الطبية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد المرضى للتصوير وتهيئتهم وفق الأوضاع السليمة، وتحديد واختيار الوسائل الوقائية المناسبة. تشغيل أجهزة التصوير الشعاعي وتصوير الحالات المختلفة للمرضى والمصابين، مع مراقبة حالتهم أثناء وبعد التصوير. تفقد وتجهيز أجهزة التحميض، ومراجعة الصور، وإجراء التحليل الأولي للتأكد من جودة التصوير. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في تقنيات التصوير بالأشعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتصوير الإشعاعي، والعمل على حفظها وتوثيقها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ جميع أعمال التصوير بالأشعة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تقنية الأشعة. القدرة على التعامل مع أجهزة التصوير الشعاعي المختلفة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ وقواعد السلامة الإشعاعية. بيئة العمل تتمثل بيئة العمل في مجمع دار الدخيل الطبي بتبوك، حيث يتم العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في الرعاية الصحية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الموقع: تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

d9e00b5304ec8020.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أواصر نجد للمقاولات عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مشروع صيانة ونظافة وتشغيل المجموعة الأولى لعدد 150 مسجدًا وجامعًا بمحافظة العرضيات بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ومتابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأعمال وتحديد المهام بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. إجادة إعداد وتقديم وحفظ التقارير. بيئة العمل سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مشروع صيانة ونظافة وتشغيل المساجد والجوامع في محافظة العرضيات بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع لضمان الإشراف المباشر على الخدمات العامة. الموقع ونوع الوظيفة الموقع: مكة المكرمة، محافظة العرضيات. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة في شركة أواصر نجد للمقاولات.

d973f807c528fd28.description: About the role As the Senior Marketing Analyst for CRM, you will be the single analytics owner of CRM - the person marketers come to as a partner. You will own how campaigns are measured, how the communication data is built and trusted, and how insights turn into decisions: what to stop, scale, or fix. You will work closely with CRM marketers, Product, and the data platform team. You define what data you need and accept its quality; you do not build the pipelines yourself. Be the analytics partner to CRM marketers and Product on every initiative. Work with them on how to improve results. Answer "how do we correctly measure CRM activity" questions: choosing the right measurement design for a campaign type (always-on journeys vs one-off blasts vs product launches), defining what "delivered" means per channel, and defending the methodology to stakeholders Explain the technical side in plain language: how an experiment works, what a holdout is for, why a number can or cannot be trusted, so marketers make decisions they actually understand Own how CRM performance is measured: control groups, holdouts, A/B tests Own the CRM analytics data in dbt on BigQuery: who gets which message, on which channel, for which product, and how often Be the customer of the data platform team: say what data you need from the CRM and attribution tools, agree on timelines, and sign off on quality. You own what the numbers mean; they build the pipelines. Build Tableau dashboards that earn their place: visualisations stakeholders can open to check a hypothesis, answer their own question, or spot an insight in minutes. Keep the self-serve AI analytics assistant up to date, so non-technical colleagues can get answers to simple questions and run their own ad-hoc analysis without waiting for an analyst Work with a data science team, ask the right questions about a recommendation or propensity model, spot when it is not doing its job, and drive the test that proves it Desired Candidate Profile 3+ years of experience as a data/marketing/CRM analyst, with exposure to CRM, lifecycle, or retention analytics Strong SQL and hands-on dbt experience (we run dbt on BigQuery); experience designing and maintaining data models, not just querying Experience with CRM engagement platforms: Customer.io , MoEngage, Braze, Iterable or similar: you understand journeys, events, profile attributes, and delivery semantics Solid experience with marketing experimentation: holdout design, global static control groups, control group integrity, A/B tests, incrementality vs attribution Proficiency in Python Proficiency in Tableau (or similar BI tool) Proactive ownership: you find problems in data and processes before stakeholders do, audit your domain independently, and bring your own agenda and ideas on how to achieve business goals. Thinking partnership: stakeholders should be able to brainstorm with you, not just hand you tasks. First-time-right quality: numbers you ship are trusted without a second verification pass; Nice-to-have You now how Uplift modeling and causal ML works and can create MVP version Propensity / churn / LTV modeling

d920f841a8b118e8.description: الوصف الوظيفي لمعلمة اللغة العربية للمرحلة التأسيسية للطفولة المبكرة (EYFS) المسمى الوظيفي — معلمة لغة عربية لمرحلة الطفولة المبكرة الموقع — جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية تاريخ مباشرة العمل — أكتوبر 2026 تسعى مدارس دولية إلى استقطاب معلمة مؤهلة لتدريس اللغة العربية في مرحلة الطفولة المبكرة، لديها خبرة في إدارة صفوف تعتمد على التعلّم القائم على اللعب باللغة العربية، وتنمية مهارات الأطفال اللغوية ومهارات القراءة والكتابة المبكرة. كما ستقدّم المعلمة دعمًا فرديًا موجّهًا للأطفال في تعلّم أصوات الحروف العربية وتنمية مهارات القراءة والكتابة المبكرة. المتطلبات الأساسية المؤهلات — درجة بكالوريوس في تخصص ذي صلة، ومؤهل تدريسي معترف به في مرحلة الطفولة المبكرة. الخبرة التدريسية — خبرة مثبتة في تدريس اللغة العربية في مرحلة الطفولة المبكرة، خاصةً في تنمية المهارات اللغوية ومهارات القراءة والكتابة. الكفاءة اللغوية — إتقان اللغة العربية تحدثًا وكتابةً، ومستوى متوسط في اللغة الإنجليزية. إدارة الصف — القدرة على تقديم أنشطة تعليمية مشوّقة قائمة على اللعب، والحفاظ على بيئة صفية إيجابية. نمو الطفل — فهم قوي لمراحل نمو الأطفال وممارسات التدريس المناسبة لأعمارهم. مهارات القراءة والكتابة بالعربية — خبرة في تعليم أصوات الحروف العربية والمفردات ومهارات القراءة والكتابة المبكرة. الدعم الفردي — القدرة على تقييم احتياجات التعلم وتقديم تدخلات موجّهة لتنمية مهارات القراءة والكتابة. التقييم والتعليم الدامج — خبرة في دعم الأطفال على اختلاف قدراتهم التعليمية وخلفياتهم اللغوية. المهارات المهنية — مهارات قوية في التواصل والعمل الجماعي والتواصل مع أولياء الأمور، مع وعي بمتطلبات حماية الأطفال. حماية الأطفال — فهم مسؤوليات حماية الأطفال، والالتزام بالحدود المهنية والسرية، والإبلاغ الفوري عن أي مخاوف وفق إجراءات المدرسة. الرخصة المهنية — يشترط الحصول على رخصة مهنية للتدريس. المؤهلات والخبرات المفضّلة خبرة في بيئة تعليمية دولية أو ثنائية اللغة في مرحلة الطفولة المبكرة. الإلمام بإطار كامبريدج للطفولة المبكرة. تدريب إضافي في تعليم الطفولة المبكرة، أو تعليم أصوات الحروف العربية، أو التدخلات الداعمة للقراءة والكتابة، أو تدريس لغة إضافية. خبرة في تطوير موارد لتعليم اللغة العربية ودعم انتقال الأطفال إلى المرحلة الابتدائية. تُفضّل مرشحة سعودية مقيمة في جدة. التقييم أثناء المقابلة يُطلب من المرشحة تقديم نشاط لتعليم اللغة العربية قائم على اللعب، وإعداد خطة تدخل فردية مختصرة لدعم مهارات القراءة والكتابة، وشرح كيفية تقييم تقدّم الأطفال وتعديل التدريس بناءً على النتائج.
